title: Cake on a Log
text: A rabbit and a robot were sitting in a sandbox by the lake. The Keeper came with a picnic basket and a cake. "Take the cake, and make a plan," said the Keeper. The Apprentice tapped the silent end of cake. "The a is long!" Happy rabbit! Happy robot! Happy picnic!

title: Rope in the Hole
text: At sunset, a note was in a tiny hole in a stone. An upset robot was hopping. A dusty rabbit was jumping. The hole is tiny, so a hand cannot fit! The Keeper made a rope. The Apprentice made a ring in the rope and gave a tug. Up came the note! Happy robot! Happy rabbit! Happy Apprentice!

title: A Fancy City
text: The Apprentice came to a fancy city. Happy, silly, tiny mice were sitting on a hilltop. A pumpkin, a magnet, a trumpet, and a helmet were in a sandbox. A nice page was in a cage by the lake. "Since the cage is tiny, slide the page," said the Keeper.

title: The Race
text: The mice were in a race on the hilltop. The prize was a ribbon. A tiny, fancy bandit was in the path twice. The Apprentice was running, jumping, and hopping past a dusty rabbit. Silly rabbit! "Tap city and age," said the Keeper.

title: The Long Note
text: The Keeper handed the Apprentice a useful note. It said, "Invite a rabbit and include a robot!" The Apprentice was confused. "Tap a long one in two," said the Keeper. The Apprentice tapped it, and the note was complete. The picnic basket was complete, and the rabbit was happy.

title: Knots and Wrecks
text: A wren was sitting on a wrecked bridge. "Unsafe!" wrote the wren. A hopeful rabbit in a costume knocked. "Unwrap the knot!" wrote the wren. The Keeper wrapped a useful, homemade rope. Safe at sunset! Happy Apprentice! The wren rewrote the note.

title: The Deepest Path
text: The path was thin. "Navigate," said the Keeper. The Apprentice tapped it, one bit at a time. "Concentrate!" said the Keeper. The Apprentice tapped activate, then illustrate, then dedicate. "Improvise!" A rabbit, a robot, and a puppy were sitting on a hilltop. A basket of lemonade was with them. "Celebrate!" said the Keeper.

title: The Forest Pages
text: In the end, the Apprentice and the Keeper lifted up the Great Word Book. The pages were back! The rabbit made lemonade. The mice were jumping with a trumpet. The robot was in a handstand. "Celebrate!" said the Keeper. "Navigate home, and dedicate a page to a friend!" Happy rabbit! Happy robot! Happy puppy!
